description: Declares that an account uses Inkwell, the native reader and writer for the Standard.site publishing ecosystem on AT Protocol.

main.description: A self-attesting record indicating the account holder uses Inkwell. The `app` field links to the canonical Inkwell app/website URI so the network-wide set of Inkwell users can be discovered via Constellation backlinks.

user.description: True when the account holder uses Inkwell. A missing or false value indicates the account does not currently declare Inkwell usage.

app.description: The canonical Inkwell app/website URI this record links to (https://inkwell.ewancroft.uk). Used as the Constellation backlink subject so all Inkwell-user records can be enumerated.
